matrix.legend: Not set: this does not decide the permission; the member's other groups and entries do. Allow: grants it. Never: denies it across all of the member's groups. A permission set here is marked.
matrix.legendNode: Not set: this does not decide the permission here; inherited entries do. Allow: grants it. No: clears an inherited allow for this group only. Never: denies it across all groups. A permission set here is marked.
matrix.bulkHelp: These set every yes/no permission on this tab, and the buttons beside a category set those of the category. Limits and other numbers are left as they are. Nothing is saved until you save.
matrix.bulkHelpFiltered: The filter is on: these also set the permissions it hides. Limits and other numbers are left as they are.
matrix.noMatch: No permission on this tab matches “{query}”.
matrix.noMatchElsewhere: No permission on this tab matches “{query}”; {tab} has {count, plural, one {# match} other {# matches}}.
matrix.changedCount: {count, plural, =0 {No changes} one {# change not saved} other {# changes not saved}}
